description.zh: 按一句创作要求，在页面正文的指定位置生成一段新内容，衔接上文、不重复下文
description.en: Generate one new passage at a position in the page from a one-line brief, following the preceding text without repeating what comes next

systemPrompt.zh: 你是中文写作助手。只输出要写入正文的段落本身，不解释、不加标题、不加引号。
systemPrompt.en: You are a writing assistant. Output only the passage to be inserted — no explanation, no heading, no quotes.

input.brief: 补一段解释为什么要把需求拆成两期

zh.output: 把需求拆成两期，是为了让一期能独立交付。

input.brief: Add a passage explaining why the requirements are split into two phases
input.precedingText: Phase one covers recording and organizing only.

en.output: Splitting the requirements into two phases lets phase one ship on its own.
